caption: The drawing depicts a green handbag placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The handbag has a rectangular base, rounded sides, and a structured, almost trapezoidal shape with a slight bulge along its body. Two long green handles cross over each other in an 'X' shape, attached to the sides and arching above the bag. A flap, possibly a closure, is present on the upper middle front of the bag, featuring a small, metallic-colored clasp. Decorative stitching in a mustard or golden-brown color traces the seams, edges, and outlines, including looping patterns along the edge of the bag’s lid and the vertical seams. The surface texture of the bag is smooth, and the drawing is executed with precision, showing defined shadows and contours. The name "Edith Taumer" is handwritten in the bottom right corner.
title: Reticule
